exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Sentence A. In addition, Sentence B".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! 文A。それに 文B matches "Sentence A. In addition, Sentence B".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is 文A。それに 文B.
exercises.explanation: Adds extra information to the previous sentence using "それに" (in addition).
